page.layout: One block of text in one column; a list of Greek words with English glosses running down the page; a catchword-like Greek word at the lower right, set apart from the list. No margin notes.

main_text.p: immiscere, ne aliena nobis arrogare videremur.

page.notes: Several Greek words and glosses are uncertain in this scan, notably the entries after "Καχάω" and the final catchword; the Greek accents and breathings may be imprecise. The line "Καχάω ------" is printed with a dashed continuation as shown.
